bio: Expect ambitious cuisine is in a classic/French vein with regional and seasonal influences – dishes include the likes of seared scallops on orange fennel, and the classic Zwiebelrostbraten (beef and onions in gravy). You can dine à la carte or opt for the set menu – available in an omnivore or vegetarian version. Attentive and charming service is the forte of the lady of the house. The interior is modern and elegant, and in winter tables by the fireplace are very much in demand. In summer, the garden terrace is a boon. There are attractive rooms for overnight guests....
